Package org.cyclops.colossalchests2.inventory

Record Class ChestLayout

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.cyclops.colossalchests2.inventory.ChestLayout
public record ChestLayout(int slotCount, int columns, int rows) extends Record
Positions in the chest GUI, shared by the menu and the screen. The grid has 9 columns up to 54 slots and 18 above that, so 108 slots still fit a 240 pixel high screen. A last row that is not full is centered.
